steps.title: Niyat
steps.description: Tahorat olish niyatini qiling: 'Alloh taoloning roziligi uchun tahorat olmoqchiman.'

steps.title: Bismillah
steps.description: 'Bismillahir rohmanir rohiym' deb boshlang.

steps.title: Qo'llarni yuvish
steps.description: Ikkala qo'lni bilakkacha 3 marta yuving.

steps.title: Og'izni chayqash (Madmada)
steps.description: Og'izga suv olib 3 marta yaxshilab chayqang. Ro'za tutmagan bo'lsangiz tomoqqa yetguncha chayqash sunnat.

steps.title: Burnini tozalash (Istinshoq)
steps.description: Burniga 3 marta suv torting va chap qo'l bilan tozalang.

steps.title: Yuzni yuvish
steps.description: Yuzni — soch bitadigan joydan iyak ostigacha, bir quloqdan ikkinchi quloqgacha — 3 marta yuving. Bu farzdir.

steps.title: Qo'llarni tirsakkkacha yuvish
steps.description: Avval o'ng qo'lni, so'ng chap qo'lni tirsak bilan birga 3 martadan yuving. Bu farzdir.

steps.title: Boshni masх qilish
steps.description: Ho'l qo'llar bilan butun boshni bir marta masх qiling. Bu sunnat. Kamida boshning to'rtdan bir qismini masх qilish farzdir.

steps.title: Quloqlarni masх qilish
steps.description: Ko'rsatkich barmoqlar bilan quloqning ichini, bosh barmoqlar bilan tashqarisini masх qiling.

steps.title: Bo'yinni masх qilish
steps.description: Qo'l orqasi bilan bo'yinning yon va orqa qismini masх qiling. Bu sunnatdir.

steps.title: Oyoqlarni yuvish
steps.description: Avval o'ng oyoqni, so'ng chap oyoqni to'piq bilan birga 3 martadan yuving. Barmoq oralari ham yuvilsin. Bu farzdir.

steps.title: Niyat
steps.description: Qaysi namazni o'qiyotganingizni niyat qiling. Masalan: 'Bugungi bomdod namazining 2 rakat farzini o'qimoqchi bo'ldim Alloh uchun.' Qiblaga yuzlaning.

steps.title: Takbiroti tahrima
steps.description: Qo'llarni quloq barobari ko'tarib 'Allohu Akbar' deng. Namoz boshlandi — mundan keyin gapirishning, yeyishning iloji yo'q.

steps.title: Qiyom — Sano
steps.description: Qo'llarni kindik ostiga bog'lang (erkaklar) yoki ko'krak ustiga (ayollar). 'Subhanakallohumma va bihamdika va tabarokasmuka va ta'ala jadduka va la ilaha ghayruk' deng.

steps.title: Ta'avvuz va Basmala
steps.description: 'A'uzu billahi minash-shaytanir-rojim. Bismillahir-rohmanir-rohiym' deng.

steps.title: Fotiha surasi
steps.description: Al-Fotiha surasini to'liq o'qing. Oxirida 'Omin' deng (sekin).

steps.title: Qo'shimcha sura
steps.description: Qur'ondan biron sura yoki kamida 3 qisqa oyat o'qing.

steps.title: Ruku'
steps.description: 'Allohu Akbar' deb ruku'ga boring. Belni tekis, boshni bel bilan bir tekislikda tuting. Qo'llar bilan tizzalarni ushlang. Kamida 3 marta 'Subhana rabbiyal azim' deng.

steps.title: Qavma (tik turish)
steps.description: 'Sami'allohu liman hamidah' deb tik turing. 'Robbana lakal hamd' deng.

steps.title: Birinchi sajda
steps.description: 'Allohu Akbar' deb sajdaga tushing. Peshona, burun, ikkala kaft, tizzalar va oyoq barmoqlari yerga tegsin. Kamida 3 marta 'Subhana rabbiyal a'la' deng.

steps.title: Jalsa (ikki sajda orasi)
steps.description: 'Allohu Akbar' deb o'tiring. Bir lahza tinch o'tirib, 'Rabbig'firli' deng.

steps.title: Ikkinchi sajda
steps.description: 'Allohu Akbar' deb yana sajdaga tushing. Kamida 3 marta 'Subhana rabbiyal a'la' deng. Birinchi rakat tamom.

steps.title: Ikkinchi rakatga turish
steps.description: 'Allohu Akbar' deb to'g'ridan-to'g'ri turib keting. Qo'llarni bog'lab, Bismillah, Fotiha va sura o'qing. Ruku' va sajdalarni xuddi birinchi rakatdek takrorlang.

steps.title: Oxirgi qa'da (o'tirish)
steps.description: Ikkinchi rakatning ikkinchi sajdasidan so'ng o'tiring. Attahiyyot, Salavot (Allohumma salli...) va duo o'qing. Masalan: 'Robbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan va fil-akhirati hasanatan va qina azaban-nar.'

steps.title: Salom
steps.description: Avval o'ng tomonga 'Assalamu alaykum va rohmatulloh', so'ng chap tomonga ham aytib salom bering. Namoz tamom.

steps.title: Birinchi va ikkinchi rakat
steps.description: 2 rakatli namozdek o'qiladi: Niyat → Takbir → Sano → Fotiha + sura → Ruku' → Sajdalar. Ikkinchi rakatda ham Fotiha + sura o'qiladi.

steps.title: Birinchi qa'da (qa'da ula)
steps.description: Ikkinchi rakatdan so'ng o'tiring. FAQAT Attahiyyot o'qing. Salavot o'qilMAYDI. Bu qa'da vojibdir.

steps.title: Uchinchi rakatga turish
steps.description: 'Allohu Akbar' deb turing. FAQAT Fotiha o'qing, sura qo'shilMAYDI (farzda). Ruku' va sajdalarni bajaring.

steps.title: To'rtinchi rakat
steps.description: Uchinchi rakatdek: faqat Fotiha (sura qo'shilmaydi). Ruku' va sajdalarni bajaring.

steps.title: Oxirgi qa'da (qa'da akhira)
steps.description: To'rtinchi rakatning ikkinchi sajdasidan so'ng o'tiring. Attahiyyot + Salavot + Duo o'qing. Bu farzdir.

steps.title: Salom
steps.description: Ikkala tomonga salom berib namozni yakunlang.

steps.title: Birinchi va ikkinchi rakat
steps.description: Odatdagi kabi: Niyat → Takbir → Sano → Fotiha + sura → Ruku' → Sajdalar.

steps.title: Birinchi qa'da
steps.description: Ikkinchi rakatdan so'ng o'tiring. FAQAT Attahiyyot o'qing. Salavot o'qilMAYDI.

steps.title: Uchinchi rakat
steps.description: 'Allohu Akbar' deb turing. Faqat Fotiha o'qing, sura qo'shilMAYDI (farzda). Ruku' va sajdalarni bajaring.

steps.title: Oxirgi qa'da
steps.description: O'tiring: Attahiyyot + Salavot + Duo o'qing.

steps.title: Salom
steps.description: Ikkala tomonga salom bering. Namoz tamom.

steps.title: Niyat
steps.description: 3 rakat vitr namaziga niyat qiling. Vitr namozi Hanafiy mazhabida vojibdir.

steps.title: Birinchi ikki rakat
steps.description: Oddiy 2 rakatli namozdek o'qing: Fotiha + sura har rakatda. Ikkinchi rakatdan so'ng o'tirib faqat Attahiyyot o'qing (Salavot o'qilMAYDI). Salom bermang.

steps.title: Uchinchi rakat — Fotiha va sura
steps.description: 'Allohu Akbar' deb turing. Fotiha va ustiga biron sura o'qing.

steps.title: Qunut duosi
steps.description: Suradan keyin 'Allohu Akbar' deb qo'llarni quloq barobari ko'taring, so'ng bog'lab Qunut duosini o'qing. Qunut bilmasangiz 3 marta 'Allohummagfirli' deyish ham mumkin.

steps.title: Ruku' va sajdalar
steps.description: Odatdagi kabi ruku' qiling, so'ng qavma (tik turish), so'ng ikkala sajdani bajaring.

steps.title: Oxirgi qa'da va salom
steps.description: O'tirib Attahiyyot, Salavot va duo o'qing. Ikkala tomonga salom bering. Vitr namozi tamom.
